functional.description: A saved plain-English checklist must compile through the approved R2D2/Vertex gateway into a bounded, schema-valid Playwright artifact without exposing secrets.
functional.rationale: PRD §§5.2-5.3 and Epic 10 define compiled Playwright as the only execution truth.

functional.description: The user must review and confirm the exact immutable artifact revision and hash that execution will consume.
A confirmed revision must dispatch durably to the isolated runner exactly once per accepted attempt, with cancellation and recovery preserving honest outcomes.
functional.rationale: PRD reliability and Epic 10 dispatch/recovery contracts require durable admission without ambiguous replay.

functional.description: The runner must validate the closed Playwright language, execute it in pinned Chromium, and report aligned step results without runtime LLM access.
functional.rationale: The security boundary depends on deterministic validation and isolated execution.

functional.description: Every normal browser run must finalize native video when possible, upload video and a redacted result manifest, and keep evidence outcome independent from check outcome.
functional.rationale: PRD §5.2 defines inspectable video proof and honest partial/unavailable states.

functional.description: Authorized users must receive live SSE progress with GET fallback and must be able to seek, range-stream, and download available evidence through the protected API.
functional.rationale: PRD live-progress and evidence requirements cover the complete user-visible run.

functional.description: The Studio UI must display the exact confirmed Playwright artifact and hash rather than candidate, draft-derived, or client-generated source.
functional.rationale: The Code view must show what will actually run.

functional.description: Deployment configuration required by API, worker, and runner must reach each process and fail closed when invalid or ambiguous.
functional.rationale: A configured safety control that Kubernetes silently drops is not a control.

nonFunctional.description: Identity, CSI authorization, secret references, service credentials, runner egress, and evidence access must fail closed and leak no resolved secret.
nonFunctional.metric: Credentialed staging pilot passes authorization, canary, vault and ingress checks with zero secret leakage.

nonFunctional.description: Accepted work, final results and evidence disposition must survive process restarts without automatic replay of an ambiguous browser attempt.
nonFunctional.metric: Integrated restart, duplicate callback, delayed manifest and reaper scenarios pass.

nonFunctional.description: Compilation, execution, evidence and streaming must obey explicit byte, time, concurrency and retention bounds.
nonFunctional.metric: All configured bounds are positive, rendered, enforced and measured under staging load.

nonFunctional.description: Compile, run, cancellation, partial evidence, unavailable evidence and expiry must be distinguishable in accessible UI text.
nonFunctional.metric: Automated accessibility checks pass and the required manual assistive-technology/browser review is recorded.

constraints.description: Compilation may call the LLM only during authoring; confirmed execution must never call an LLM.
constraints.impact: Compiler and runner remain separate trust zones.

constraints.description: The production runner uses the pinned Playwright and Chromium image and the closed artifact grammar already present in the repository.
constraints.impact: No arbitrary JavaScript, eval, filesystem, database or gateway access is allowed in artifacts.

constraints.description: Production certification requires the real enterprise R2D2, Core identity/vault, Sonic and cluster ingress/egress services.
constraints.impact: Local mocks and fixtures cannot close staging gates.

constraints.description: Video can contain sensitive target-page content and remains private, CSI-authorized and logically expired after the approved retention window.
constraints.impact: Storage lifecycle and retrieval authorization require Security and platform acceptance.

constraints.description: All runtime HTTP calls use the centralized frontend API client; MSW is restricted to directly imported test fixtures.
constraints.impact: Frontend integration must preserve the production transport boundary without a browser mock mode.

assumptions.description: R2D2 remains Vertex-compatible for the configured request/structured-output contract.
Sonic provides the S3-compatible range and lifecycle semantics required by the evidence contracts.
The platform gateway supplies trusted identity and an approved CSRF posture for ambient-session mutations and media.

domainModel.description: Mutable authored checklist and configuration with optimistic revisions.
Immutable artifact, hash, expected intent and compiler provenance.
Accepted immutable attempt and status/evidence snapshot.
relationships: has result manifest and optional video

domainModel.description: Native WebM plus redacted manifest and lifecycle metadata.

interactions.description: Save checklist, compile, review exact artifact, confirm, run, observe progress, inspect video and source.

edgeCases.scenario: Gateway unavailable, malformed output or exhausted repair budget
edgeCases.handling: Keep draft saved; publish bounded STALE or NEEDS_REVISION state and never auto-confirm.

edgeCases.scenario: Cancel, timeout, pod loss or duplicate callback during a browser attempt
edgeCases.handling: Stop/reap the process tree, preserve a known outcome, record honest partial/unavailable evidence and never replay ambiguously.

edgeCases.scenario: Object store is absent or unreachable
edgeCases.handling: Distinguish absence from infrastructure failure; never rewrite the check outcome.

edgeCases.scenario: Candidate differs from the confirmed revision after an edit/recompile
edgeCases.handling: Run and Code view continue to use the immutable confirmed artifact; candidate review remains separate.

edgeCases.scenario: A deployment property produces an invalid or colliding environment name

terminology.definition: Validated immutable artifact awaiting explicit confirmation.
Immutable artifact and hash that execution is authorized to consume.
Availability/partiality of video and manifest, independent of check outcome.
Local gates are green and all named real-infrastructure staging acceptance gates have passed.

openQuestions.question: What production R2D2 endpoint, model, credentials, quotas and structured-output behavior are approved for Studio?
Which linked Core identity/vault delivery replaces the remaining production stubs and documents CSRF behavior?
Which Sonic endpoint, principals and lifecycle policy have passed real range/read/write/version cleanup tests?
Which staging cluster and approved internal target close sandbox, egress, ingress, SSE/media and seek-calibration measurements?
